title: Studio Ghibli Finally Confirms Exciting New Project For 2026
content: Even decades after its establishment in 1985, Studio Ghibli has remained the most iconic animation studio when it comes to anime movies. Every film produced by the studio is loved for its striking visuals, rich storytelling, and deep emotional impact.
author: ComicBook

title: 35 Years Ago, Dragon Ball Z Redefined Shonen With The Greatest Transformation of All Time
content: Akira Toriyama’s iconic Dragon Ball manga released its anime adaptation in two parts, with Dragon Ball Z covering the second, much longer half of the original series. While the original series sets up the foundation of the story, DBZ helped popularize the franchise compared to other series.
author: ComicBook

title: Crunchyroll’s Major Fantasies Unveil Exciting New Look At Beloved Characters
content: Almost a decade since the manga’s debut, Witch Hat Atelier finally premiered its highly anticipated anime on Crunchyroll as part of the Spring 2026 lineup. The anime was confirmed in 2022 and was supposed to be released in 2025, but the production took longer than expected, and fans can see why.
author: ComicBook

title: Attack on Titan: 5 Things Fans Don’t Want to Admit About the Anime
content: Attack on Titan is one of the biggest anime of the last couple of decades, and its reputation is undoubtedly deserved — but while it’s a great series, there are things many fans don’t want to admit about it. The anime tends to spark heated debates, especially when it comes to certain topics.
author: ComicBook

title: Crunchyroll’s Biggest Isekai Is Officially Ending Latest Season
content: The highly anticipated Spring 2026 anime season is finally here with an exciting lineup of some of the best anime ever. The lineup also includes the return of some major series with new seasons, including Re:Zero − Starting Life in Another World Season 4.

title: Netflix’s Biggest Anime of The Year Unveils Gorgeous New Look Ahead of Debut
content: Ever since the year began, Netflix has been dropping one exciting anime series and film after another, including Love Through a Prism, Cosmic Princess Kaguya, Baki-Dou: The Invincible Samurai, and many more.
author: ComicBook

title: Solo Leveling’s Upcoming Show Gets a Major New Update
content: Solo Leveling premiered its highly anticipated Season 2 last year as part of the Winter 2025 lineup and adapted the best arc of the story. The latest season was a rollercoaster of emotions as Jinwoo finally managed to wake his mother up from her eternal slumber.
author: ComicBook

title: Now’s the Time to Binge This Perfect Summer Anime Before Its Return Next Month
content: Summer is here, and that means a new season of anime to look forward to — and this one heralds the return of a perfect seasonal binge. Most anime make for great viewing experiences year-round, and it’s never too late to catch up on the best shonen series or isekai adventures of 2026 .
author: ComicBook

title: Tsukumizu to Launch 'Shoujo Shuumatsu Ryokou' Prequel Manga in June 2026
content: Shinchosha's Kurage Bunch announced that Tsukumizu will begin drawing a prequel to their Shoujo Shuumatsu Ryokou ( Girls' Last Tour ) manga, titled Kaisou Toshi Tanpenshuu ( Collected Fragments of a Layered City ), on the website on June 26.
author: MyAnimeList
